qualification.details: Technician: B.Sc. in Radiological Imaging Technology from a recognized University. B.Sc. in any subject plus 2 years Advanced Diploma in Medical Imaging Technology (ADMIT) plus 1-year completed Internship. B.Sc. in any subject plus 2 years Diploma in Medical Imaging Technology from any recognized Board/University plus 1-year completed Internship. Experience: Mandatory Competency: The candidate should be competent to independently perform X-ray, CT, MRI, DEXA, OPG and fluoroscopy examinations and should be willing to work across different imaging modalities as per departmental requirements. Desirable Experience: Experience in Mammography or Interventional Radiology (IR) is desirable.

Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities.
Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for TMC ACTREC Technician Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the Advanced Centre for Treatment, Research and Education in Cancer (TMC ACTREC), a renowned institution in the healthcare sector.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The post name for which the walk-in interview is being conducted is Technician- Radio diagnosis.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for TMC ACTREC Technician- Radio diagnosis recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is a Walk-in Interview. Interested candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q4. What is the walk-in interview date for Technician- Radio diagnosis?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Technician- Radio diagnosis post is scheduled for 31 August 2026. Candidates should report between 10:00 a.m. to 10:30 a.m.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the Technician- Radio diagnosis post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Technician- Radio diagnosis post is 30 years. Age relaxation may be applicable based on relevant experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for Technician- Radio diagnosis at TMC ACTREC?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary for the Technician- Radio diagnosis post ranges from ₹ 26,210 to ₹ 35,000/- per month, depending on experience and qualifications.

faq.question: Q7. What are the essential qualifications for Technician- Radio diagnosis?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a B.Sc. in Radiological Imaging Technology, or a B.Sc. with an Advanced Diploma in Medical Imaging Technology (ADMIT) plus internship, or a B.Sc. with a Diploma in Medical Imaging Technology plus internship.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at 3rd Floor, Paymaster Shodhika TMC-ACTREC, Sec-22, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai- 410210. Candidates must report at the specified time.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates need to bring their Bio-data, recent passport size photograph, scanned copies of Aadhar Card, PAN CARD, ORIGINAL and Self Attested copies of qualification Mark sheet, certificates and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for the TMC ACTREC Technician- Radio diagnosis walk-in interview. Candidates can attend without paying any fee.
